>
[Songbird's Call](/Feats.aspx?ID=5419) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 65

**Prerequisites**
[zoophonia muse](/Muses.aspx?ID=9)

</column>

---

You call to the wilds with the voice of a songbird, thereby summoning a cloud of its kin. You learn the [_songbird's call_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1944) composition spell.
